{"code": "import numpy as np

# Compute overall response rates after deduplication
overall_rate_treatment = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment', 'responded'].mean()
overall_rate_control = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control', 'responded'].mean()
raw_difference = overall_rate_treatment - overall_rate_control

# Compute weighted average of stratum-specific effects
# We have stratum_effects from earlier
stratum_effects = {}
for severity in ['mild', 'moderate', 'severe']:
    rate_control = df_dedup.loc[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == severity), 'responded'].mean()
    rate_treatment = df_dedup.loc[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment') & (df_dedup['severity'] == severity), 'responded'].mean()
    effect = rate_treatment - rate_control
    stratum_effects[severity] = effect

stratum_effects_df = pd.DataFrame(list(stratum_effects.items()), columns=['severity', 'effect'])

n_total = len(df_dedup)
weight_mild = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'mild').sum() / n_total
weight_moderate = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate').sum() / n_total
weight_severe = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum() / n_total
weights = [weight_mild, weight_moderate, weight_severe]

overall_effect = np.average(list(stratum_effects.values()), weights=weights)

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Overall response rate - treatment: {overall_rate_treatment:.6f}')
print(f'Overall response rate - control: {overall_rate_control:.6f}')
print(f'Raw difference (treatment - control): {raw_difference:.6f}')
print(f'Weighted stratum-specific difference: {overall_effect:.6f}')"}
